title: Two Hamzahs in One Word - when the second carries a kasrah: أَ إِ
titleEn: Two Hamzahs in One Word - when the second carries a kasrah: أَ إِ
description: Refer to the `two hamzahs in one word - when both carry hamzahs carry a fatha` for an introduction to these rules.

tashil_of_second_with_idkhal.title: Tashῑl of 2nd with idkhāl
tashil_of_second_with_idkhal.description: Tashῑl as described before refers to reciting a hamzah with a blend of the long vowel corresponding to the ḥarakah (short vowel) on it. Idkhāl refers to adding an alif between two hamzahs. Thus tashῑl of 2nd with idkhāl means to recite the first of the two hamzahs clearly (taḥqīq), inserting an alif after it thereby creating a natural madd and reciting the second hamzah with a blend of the long vowel alif.

tashil_of_second_without_idkhal.title: Tashῑl of 2nd without idkhāl
tashil_of_second_without_idkhal.description: Tashῑl as described before refers to reciting a hamzah with a blend of the long vowel corresponding to the ḥarakah (short vowel) on it. Idkhāl refers to adding an alif between two hamzahs. Thus tashῑl of 2nd without idkhāl means to recite the first of the two hamzahs clearly (taḥqīq) and reciting the second hamzah with a blend of the long vowel alif.

ibdaal_of_second_alif.title: Ibdāl of 2nd
ibdaal_of_second_alif.description: Ibdāl of second hamza into an alif - meaning the first of the two hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) and elongated as the second hamzah is now an alif of madd.

tahqiq_of_both_with_idkhal.title: Taḥqīq of both with idkhāl
tahqiq_of_both_with_idkhal.description: Both hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) and the first will be elongated as an alif of madd in inserted after it (idkhāl).

tahqiq_of_both_without_idkhal.title: Taḥqīq of both without idkhāl
tahqiq_of_both_without_idkhal.description: Both hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) with no changes made to either.
